texts.en:
We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是轮回之终末，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：“时机未到。”缓了一下后。“但并非不可。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

只要我们能带向终末。
texts.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

我们有50年的时间来将星系吞入其终末光环之中。如果成功，游戏将会结束。
别这么做。

Replaces the domains of all known patrons with the End of the Cycle.
We will be granted at least 50 years to consume the galaxy in the Aura of the End. If we succeed, the game ends.
Do not do this.

Technologies Gained:

label.en: Exit the Shroud and try to forget.

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

label.en: Exit the Shroud and try to forget.
Our path is set. We walk alone.

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。终末光环每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the Aura of the End consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末的契约给[this.GetName]带来了毁灭，余下的只有我们往昔强盛帝国的断壁残垣。

超主的破坏欲具现化为一个强大的能量生物——最终清算。它在星球之间漫游，吞噬人口来重获自己的力量。
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle led to the destruction of the [this.GetName], leaving behind only a vestige of our once-powerful empire.

The destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as an immense energy being - the Reckoning. It moves from world to world, restoring its strength by consumption of their populations.

texts.zh: [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: The Reckoning of the [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName] is wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

texts.zh: 有许多被称为最终清算的实体正在给星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: Multiple entities known as Reckonings are wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便虚境也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], even the Shroud feels oddly unsettled, as though its forces tremble in quiet apprehension.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长，还目睹了一个负面的灵能光环正在四处侵蚀。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse Psionic Aura. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。

texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse Psionic Aura. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 我们不知道是什么正在逼近，只知道它绝对会来。
texts.en: We do not know exactly what approaches, though we sense its coming with profound certainty.

label.zh: 我们必须做好最坏的准备。
label.en: We must prepare for the worst.

tooltips.zh: 终末光环覆盖全星系时游戏将会结束。
tooltips.en: If the Aura of the End covers the galaxy, the game ends.

texts.zh:
我们已经与轮回之终末签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的灵能光环降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
We have forged a Covenant with the End of the Cycle, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense Psionic Aura. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh:
我们的命运与轮回之终末绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
texts.en:
Our fate is bound to the End of the Cycle; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
texts.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.

label.en: We must do all that is necessary.

    —['edict:annihilation_of_energy', 能量湮灭][GetDimensionalCollapseEdictGain]

texts.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
texts.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

texts.zh: 该终末光环正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
texts.en: The Aura of the End is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与轮回之终末签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：“时日已到。”

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经虚境的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: "THE END BEGINS."

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

label.zh: 愿神灵对我们怀有仁慈。
label.en: May the spirits have mercy on us all.

texts.zh:
凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，奥伏戎便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入虚境之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
texts.en:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!
